root.label: Trump rejects Secret Service plan to demolish Oval Office

events.label: Trump rejects Secret Service plan to demolish Oval Office

slots.name: ballroom size
slots.sentence: Last October he demolished the East Wing to make space for a 90,000-square-foot ballroom.

slots.name: demolition status
slots.sentence: “I said, ‘My a–, you can’t build a new one. This is a special place,'” the president continued.

slots.name: landmark status
slots.sentence: “I’ve been asking Susie for six months to give me a statement. Will we save this room? Will we make it a federal landmark?” Trump said, referring to his chief of staff, Susie Wiles.
